text:
Type: striped fringed area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, bohemian
Materials: woven pile with textured stripes, white tasseled fringe
Colors: charcoal grey, navy black, light grey, white
Shape: large rectangle, dense narrow horizontal stripes of nubby texture, small tassels on short ends, medium pile, solid visual weight
Feel: moody, cozy, grounded
Goes with: dark wood floors, beige upholstery, natural baskets; modern or industrial rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Sophia Contemporary Area Rug, 7' 6" x 9' 6", Grey
product.description: Complete your modern-style home decor with this beautiful rug. Muted colors create an attractive woven design that suits many interior-design styles, and the fringe accent provides added elegance. 7'6" x 9'6" 100% polypropylene Machine made 0.75 High
